page0.text:
There's no time to think.
My legs move, and my arms still work.
I just need to move up and pull Tohsaka back...

page1.text:
"Tohsaka!"
"Huh?"
Tohsaka doesn't even twitch when I grab her arm.
She's heavier than she looks.

page2.text:
"Ngh. Damn, you're heavy!"
I can't budge her even with two hands.
So all I can do...
"Come on, just get back!"
...is shoulder tackle her out of the way!

page4.text:
"You—what the heck you are you doing!?"
"Toh..."
I can't hear Tohsaka's voice.

page5.text:
...My body is hot.
My vision gets all soft and twisty, like I've caught a serious fever.
"Senpai?"
...I think I hear a familiar voice, far away.
I'm losing my grip on reality.
In my white, hazy mind, the blood coming from my left arm mixes like paint on a canvas.
"No..."
With her hands clenched at her chest, Sakura stares in shock at me on the ground.
"NOOOOOOOOOOO!!!"
I see her fall like a puppet with its strings cut.
"How are you feeling? Have you calmed down?"
"..."
Sitting on one of the church pews, I nod wordlessly.

page6.text: "Okay. Then you don't need healing. You'll recover along with your physical stamina, so try to rest for now."

page7.text:
Tohsaka takes a seat a slight distance from me.
...But our emotional distance is many times wider.
We're just waiting in the chapel for Kotomine, not making small talk.

page8.text:
"Ngh."
When I try to clench my left hand, it twitches numbly.
The pain feels like a nail was driven through my palm.
My left hand hurt more from gripping the knife than the dull pain of Rider's beating or Sakura stabbing me through the left arm.

page9.text:
Dark clouds obscure the night sky.
They seem like rain clouds announcing an imminent shower.

page10.text:
"..."
...The spear-like thing that attacked Tohsaka was apparently Sakura's magecraft.

page11.text:
The Matous pass down Absorption magecraft through their family.
Sakura unconsciously unleashed her magecraft because she was suffering from magical energy deficiency.
She targeted Tohsaka because she had the most magical energy there.
When I pushed Tohsaka out of the way and that thing touched me, it caught my left arm and drained me dry of my power.

page12.text:
Magical energy is life energy.
It stands to reason that one would collapse if it was taken away.
Already exhausted from fighting Rider, I fainted right away, and then Tohsaka brought us to the chruch.
...She says that Sakura lost consciousness at the same time I did.
